# American Dental Association

> The American Dental Association (ADA) is the premier professional organization providing clinical guidelines, continuing education, dental coding standards, peer-reviewed research, and advocacy resources for dentists and dental professionals.

The ADA serves as the authoritative source for dental education, licensure support, professional development, and industry standards. The site offers membership services, accredited educational programs, examination administration, and comprehensive resources for dental practice management and patient care.

## Key Topics

- American Dental Association (ADA)
- Continuing Education
- Dental Licensure
- INBDE (Integrated National Board Dental Examination)
- CDT Code (Dental Coding)
- DENTPIN
- JADA (Journal of the American Dental Association)
- Professional Development
- Dental Education
- Membership
- Advocacy and Policy
- Clinical Guidelines
- Dental Admission Test (DAT)
- CODA Program Accreditation
- Practice Management

## Membership & Professional Services

- [Join the American Dental Association](https://www.ada.org/join-the-ada): ADA membership benefits and enrollment information
- [Renew Your Membership](https://www.ada.org/join-the-ada/renew-ada-membership): Membership renewal portal for ADA members
- [Manage your DENTPIN](https://www.ada.org/education/manage-your-dentpin): DENTPIN management for dental education and exam registration

## Education & Professional Development

- [Continuing Education](https://www.ada.org/education/continuing-education): ADA CE courses, webinars, and professional development
- [Scientific Session](https://www.ada.org/education/scientific-session): ADA 2026 Scientific Session conference in Indianapolis
- [Dental Admission Tests and Exams](https://www.ada.org/education/testing): DAT, ADAT, and dental licensure exam information
- [CODA Program Finder](https://www.ada.org/education/coda-program-finder): Find CODA-accredited dental education programs and schools
- [Licensure Overview](https://www.ada.org/resources/careers/licensure): Dental licensure requirements and INBDE exam information

## Research & Publications

- [JADA](https://www.ada.org/publications/jada): Journal of the American Dental Association peer-reviewed research
- [JADA Foundational Science](https://www.ada.org/publications/jada-foundational-science): JADA Foundational Science open-access dental research journal
- [The Code on Dental Procedures and Nomenclature (CDT Code)](https://www.ada.org/publications/cdt): CDT Code dental coding standards and procedures

## News, Resources & Community

- [New Dentist News](https://www.ada.org/publications/new-dentist-news): News and resources for new dentists and dental students
- [New Dentist Blog](https://newdentistblog.ada.org): New dentist blog covering careers, loans, and financial planning
- [Dental Sound Bites Podcast](https://www.ada.org/publications/dental-sound-bites): ADA podcast for dentists on professional and clinical topics

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Advocacy](https://www.ada.org/advocacy): ADA advocacy, government affairs, and dental policy

## Products & Store

- [ADA Store Homepage](https://engage.ada.org/pages/storehome): ADA Store homepage for dental products and resources
- [ADA Store Products](https://www.ada.org/publications/ada-store-products): ADA products for practice management and patient education

## Optional

- [Home](https://www.ada.org): ADA homepage with clinical guidelines, research, and industry news
- [Become a Volunteer Test Constructor](https://www.ada.org/education/testing/volunteer-test-constructor): Volunteer test constructor opportunities for dental exams
